content:
Returns a summary of agents in safe mode for your container. The summary includes the total
number of agents along with breakdowns by agent version and operating system platform.
Note: Agent safe mode is supported by agent version 10.9.0 and later.
For more information about agent safe mode, see Agent Safe Mode in the Tenable Vulnerability
Management User Guide and Safe Mode in the Tenable Agent User Guide.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
